key.name: theme
key.description: Whether the app follows the desktop's colour scheme or overrides it.

key.name: reading-width-limited
key.description: Whether a document's text is held to a comfortable measure rather than filling the window.

key.name: reading-width
key.description: The measure a document's text is held to, in rem — multiples of the document's base font size.

key.name: autosave
key.description: Whether edits are written back to the file without being asked for.

key.name: autosave-delay
key.description: How long after the last edit an automatic save happens, in seconds.

key.name: spellcheck
key.description: Whether misspelled words are marked in the editor. Reading is never affected.

key.name: engine
key.description: The parser new documents are rendered with, named by its engine id.

key.name: disabled-plugins
key.description: The ids of the rendering plugins the reader has switched off. A plugin is on unless it is named here, so a newly added one arrives enabled.
